from solution import replace_blank


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: example hello people with @."""
    # expected "hello"(5) + "@"(1) + "people"(6) = 5+1+6 = 12 chars
    assert replace_blank("hello people", "@") == "hello@people"


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: empty string stays empty."""
    # expected "" has 0 chars: 0+0 = 0
    assert replace_blank("", "@") == ""


def test_issue_no_blanks_unchanged():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: string without blanks unchanged."""
    # expected "hello" has 5 chars: 5+0 = 5
    assert replace_blank("hello", "@") == "hello"


def test_issue_multiple_words():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: each blank in a b c replaced."""
    # expected "a-b-c" has 5 chars: 1+1+1+1+1 = 5
    assert replace_blank("a b c", "-") == "a-b-c"


def test_issue_consecutive_blanks():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: consecutive blanks each replaced."""
    # expected "a@@b" has 4 chars: 1+2+1 = 4
    assert replace_blank("a  b", "@") == "a@@b"


def test_issue_leading_blank():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: leading blank is replaced."""
    # expected "_hello" has 6 chars: 1+5 = 6
    assert replace_blank(" hello", "_") == "_hello"


def test_issue_trailing_blank():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: trailing blank is replaced."""
    # expected "hello_" has 6 chars: 5+1 = 6
    assert replace_blank("hello ", "_") == "hello_"


def test_issue_only_blanks():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: string of only blanks fully replaced."""
    # expected "XXX" has 3 chars: 1+1+1 = 3
    assert replace_blank("   ", "X") == "XXX"


def test_issue_any_replacement_character():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: works for any given character."""
    # expected "hello-people" has 12 chars: 5+1+6 = 12
    assert replace_blank("hello people", "-") == "hello-people"


def test_contract_preserves_other_characters():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: must not alter non-blank characters."""
    # expected "a1!"(3) + "@"(1) + "b2?"(3) = 3+1+3 = 7 chars
    assert replace_blank("a1! b2?", "@") == "a1!@b2?"


def test_contract_space_for_space_unchanged():
    """Replace blank spaces with any character: replacing blank with blank keeps string."""
    # expected "a b" has 3 chars: 1+1+1 = 3
    assert replace_blank("a b", " ") == "a b"
